policyNotes: Trade inconvenience is not an optimization cost; only legality/timing is modeled.
Pure trade evolution is considered available from stage 0 (Pokédex/Union Room before Falkner benchmark).
EVO_TRADE_ITEM requires both trading and a source-backed item source.
Rare wild held-item sources are derived automatically from pinned pret personal+encounter data and treated as repeatable; drop-rate friction is ignored.
Curated fixed/shop sources below are conservative story stages. Weekday inconvenience is ignored, but National Dex / Rock Climb gates are respected.

ITEM_KINGS_ROCK.note: Earlier than the Surf-gated Slowpoke Well gift in this route model.

ITEM_METAL_COAT.note: Wild Magnemite held-item source is also derived automatically if earlier.

ITEM_DRAGON_SCALE.note: Wild Horsea/Seadra held-item source is derived automatically and may move this earlier.

ITEM_UPGRADE.note: Available during early Kanto before the modeled Sabrina checkpoint.

ITEM_MAGMARIZER.note: Cinnabar Island Rock Climb source; legal only after all 16 badges/Blue in the modeled route.

ITEM_PROTECTOR.note: Mt. Mortar Rock Climb source; legal after Blue and before the rematch Elite Four.

ITEM_DUBIOUS_DISC.note: Route 42/Mt. Mortar Rock Climb source; legal after Blue and before the rematch Elite Four.

ITEM_ELECTIRIZER.note: Cerulean Cave source; modeled after all 16 badges/Blue and before the rematch Elite Four.

ITEM_REAPER_CLOTH.note: Mt. Silver source; modeled after all 16 badges/Blue and before the rematch Elite Four.
